newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia c.bank will not force lower t-bill yields.
newsitem.headline: Russia c.bank will not force lower t-bill yields.

text.p: The Russian central bank will not force yields lower on domestic government securities and does not plan to change the quota on foreign T-bill holdings, now at 15 percent, chairman Sergei Dubinin said on Wednesday.

"We are not aiming to force a decrease in yields on the GKO (discount Treasury bill) market as there might be a forcing out of Russian investors, which we are not interested in," Dubinin told a news conference. "The current quota (of non-resident participation) serves the interests of the Russian Federation and foreign investors and will remain at about the current level."
